title: Staff Vendor Partner Manager, Intuit Customer Success
jobDescription: We are a high-impact, fast-moving Customer Success organization on a transformational journey. With bold goals and a deep obsession for both customer and expert experiences, we operate at velocity and with purpose to deliver measurable impact at scale. As a Staff-level individual contributor in Vendor Partner Management, you will lead multi-million-dollar customer success partnerships and deliver complex strategic initiatives that enhance service delivery, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You will be a critical bridge between internal teams and external partners, ensuring we deliver excellence and innovation across every touchpoint. Responsibilities Partner Management & Service Delivery Lead multiple high-value external partner relationships, driving performance improvement, operational consistency, and strategic alignment Hold partners accountable to KPI targets across CSAT, AHT, and Issue Resolution — initiating and tracking performance improvement plans when performance falls below threshold Facilitate Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), ensuring partners deliver data-driven pre-reads, own root-cause analysis, and execute on improvement actions Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across partner organizations to co-develop goals and long-term success plans Act as the voice of the partner internally, resolving escalations and clearing roadblocks that impede performance or customer experience Strategic Programs & Transformation Own and drive large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that impact customer support delivery, expert enablement, and operational scalability Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Operations, Finance, and Technology to co-design and execute strategic programs Take full ownership of execution details, including program setup, milestone tracking, meeting orchestration, and risk management Actively contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, bold thinking, and operational excellence Data-Driven Insight & Impact Monitor partner performance and staffing views, identifying improvement opportunities and building actionable strategies Ensure staffing delivery against capacity plans, flagging intraday gaps and coordinating real-time coverage adjustments in partnership with workforce planning Build executive-level insights to communicate progress, value, and impact of initiatives and partnerships Qualifications 8+ years of leadership experience in Vendor Partner Management, Customer Experience, Business Operations, Program Management, or Strategic Partnerships Proven track record managing BPO/vendor partnerships, with a focus on performance management and relationship development across senior stakeholders Experience with contact center KPIs, WBR/MBR cadences, and performance management frameworks Familiarity with expert enablement, change management coordination, and readiness processes in BPO or large-scale service delivery environments Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred Strong business acumen and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to balance high-level strategy and hands-on execution Demonstrated experience as a self-starter that can quickly and independently assess business requirements and become a trusted subject matter expert Deep analytical skills and comfort with data; able to drive insights, make decisions, and communicate findings effectively Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across functions with measurable business impact Demonstrated resilience, initiative, and ability to adapt in fast-paced, evolving environments Footer Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. title: Staff Facilitator & Training Coordinator
jobDescription: The Facilitator & Training Coordinator is a high-impact, shared-skill role that unifies live learning delivery and operational coordination into a single integrated position. You will facilitate ILT, VILT, and blended learning sessions that drive measurable behavior change; own end-to-end logistics, LMS administration, scheduling, and learner communications; and track Kirkpatrick L1–L2 data to fuel continuous improvement. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity — equally energized by facilitating a dynamic virtual classroom and by building a clean tracking spreadsheet the next morning. They hold two truths simultaneously: great facilitation is a craft requiring preparation, presence, and adaptability; great coordination is a discipline requiring precision, proactivity, and follow-through. Reports to the Facilitation Manager. Responsibilities Facilitation & Learning Delivery Deliver ILT and VILT sessions on customer service, product knowledge, communication skills, systems navigation, and role-specific content across new hire onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs Create an inclusive, participatory learning environment grounded in adult learning principles; use role plays, case studies, call simulations, and scenario-based exercises (learners doing 80%, facilitator guiding 20%) Facilitate nesting and on-the-job practice with coaching, feedback, and structured debriefs before learners are released to production Adjust delivery in real time based on group energy and comprehension signals; provide 1:1 and small-group coaching for learners needing reinforcement Partner with QA and Operations to align content with current KPIs, quality benchmarks, and performance standards Training Coordination & Operations Own end-to-end scheduling of sessions — calendar setup, learner invitations, rescheduling, cancellations; serve as day-of logistics lead (virtual session setup, breakout rooms, real-time issue resolution) Manage learner enrollment, waitlists, completions, and certifications in the LMS; maintain accurate, audit-ready records and distribute compliance reports Prepare and version-control training materials, workbooks, facilitator guides, and job aids; coordinate supplies, vendors, and invoicing Draft pre-training communications, reminders, pre-work instructions, and post-training follow-ups; distribute evaluation surveys within 24 hours of session close Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track and report attendance, no-show rates, completions, learner satisfaction (L1), and post-training assessment results (L2) on a weekly/monthly cadence Identify patterns (scheduling conflicts, low-completion cohorts, engagement trends) and proactively surface insights; maintain training calendars, trackers, and dashboards Participate in post-session debriefs and contribute to the Facilitator Community of Practice Qualifications Required Associate's or Bachelor's degree in HR, Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field — or equivalent professional experience 3–5 years facilitating training in contact center, customer service, financial services, or similar environments, with demonstrated success in blended learning (ILT, VILT, e Learning) 1–3 years of training coordination, learning operations, HR administration, or event/program management Experience with at least one enterprise LMS (Workday Learning, Docebo, Cornerstone On Demand, or equivalent) Proficiency with virtual platforms (Zoom, Teams, Webex, Google Meet) and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace Clear, professional written and verbal communication; comfort compiling and presenting clean, accurate metrics Preferred Certifications: ATD (CPTD/APTD), Kirkpatrick Four Levels®, ICF, or equivalent Familiarity with financial services, tax, accounting, or small business software (Quick Books, Intuit product suite) Exposure to adult learning principles (Knowles), ADDIE/SAM, and Kirkpatrick L1–L4 evaluation Coaching background with struggling/resistant learners; experience with Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira Footer Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits ). title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription: The Intuit Foresight team builds products that accelerate the adoption of new technologies and seed new businesses fueled by technology innovation . You’ll be building and prototyping applications to simplify the business of life for 60 million consumers and small businesses. Applications will span multiple business lines, including personal finance, small business accounting, and tax. You will thrive on ambiguity and experimentation while working closely with AI Scientists building the next generation of AI algorithms. You will be part of a small but high velocity team where team members frequently wear multiple hats as they build new products. The position involves close collaboration with our product, AI and design teams, as well as product teams in business units. Responsibilities Responsibilities Responsible for design of common components/frameworks/models that assist in building AI native apps, Fullstack LLM apps. Own end to end development of frameworks/models/ ML pipelines that fit use cases by working with the consuming teams and dependencies. Being able to navigate through ambiguity, lead with clarity and Po C Rapid prototyping, experimentation and iterations to build/own high accuracy/performant frameworks/models. Self organized, explore new shifts in Gen AI/AI and look at possible application/improvements in the existing use cases. Qualifications BS, MS, or Ph D degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience with 8+ years of experience in building/designing AI/ML applications. Atleast 1 year of experience working as a lead for a team with AI/ML engineers. Well versed in building with Python, Py Torch, Numpy, Pandas, Tensor Flow Machine learning fundamentals for supervised, unsupervised & reinforcement learning (i.e. classification, regression, clustering, neural networks) and experience in building production grade models with precision/recall. Understand and apply machine learning principles (training, weights, validation, testing, error, cost) optimizing for accuracy/feedback. Should establish and own metrics/optimization. Computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance (e.g., I/O and memory tuning). Experience with integrating applications and platforms with cloud technologies (e.g: AWS Sagemaker) Understanding of LLM, Lang Chain, Custom GPTs, Prompt Management, and ability to fine-tune base models to build efficient production-grade LLM apps. title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription:
As a Staff Software Engineer
- Fullstack for the Web and Mobile Developer Experience Platform, we are looking for an individual who is a self-starter with an engaging “can do” attitude to work in our Developer experience organization to help us solve some complex and challenging problems. You must be comfortable looking at and working in legacy codebases and technology. You should embrace utilizing new approaches, ideas, and technology to solve challenging problems. A prime candidate is someone comfortable working in a variety of programming languages such as Java, React UI and AWS, etc. You will be deployed in the team to enable Seamless web and mobile developer onboarding to intuit ecosystem. Set and evangelize technical vision for the team; help attract, retain, and grow key technical talent. Provide senior escalation support for critical production issues, driving root-cause resolution across AI-tooling incidents. Champion Agile/Scrum practices and continuously raise the technical bar for the team. Strong leadership experience: leading design discussions, presenting to leadership, acting as the cross-functional technical go-to person. BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Deep experience with AI/LLM frameworks, agentic workflows, and model integration (e.g., Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, Open AI/Anthropic APIs). Strong programming fluency across Python, Java Script/Type Script, and at least one OOD language (Java, C#, Go). Expertise across the full SDLC, including strong unit testing and TDD practices. Proven experience with build systems and CI/CD (Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, or equivalent), version control, and code review workflows at scale. Hands-on experience with Git Hub Enterprise Server and Artifactory (or equivalent artifact management platforms) — administration, scaling, and security hardening. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS). Strong Linux/Unix background with advanced scripting skills. Strong understanding of security best practices in coding and operations, including vulnerability management. Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical/executive audiences. Business acumen: strategic thinking, cost-vs-outcome framing, and the ability to build the case for AI tooling investment. Experience working across geographically distributed engineering centers. title: Principal Product Manager, Conversational Intelligence
jobDescription: At Intuit, our mission is to power prosperity around the world. We do this by creating products that deliver exceptional customer value. With iconic brands such as Turbo Tax, Quick Books, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp, Intuit serves more than 100 million customers globally. Intuit’s Virtual Expert Platform connects millions of customers with thousands of human experts – tax professionals, bookkeepers, and business specialists – and with the AI that works alongside them. It powers Intuit’s multi-billion-dollar expert services business, including Turbo Tax Live and Quick Books Live, blending artificial intelligence with human expertise so customers get fast, trustworthy answers at the moment they need them. Within VEP, Conversational Intelligence is the AI platform that understands every customer–expert conversation as it happens and turns it into real-time guidance, quality measurement, and learning. Operating across tens of thousands of experts, roughly 100 million customers, and billions of minutes of voice, video, screen-share, and chat each year, it is the authoritative source of truth for what happens in a conversation – and what to do about it. Most conversation analytics in the industry today, “transcribe-then-reason”: they convert speech to text, lose tone and on-screen context, and arrive seconds – or even hours – too late to change the outcome. We are building the opposite: a multimodal-first, real-time platform that reasons directly over audio, video, and screen streams; understands tone and intent, not just words; and delivers insight in under three seconds, live in the conversation. It coaches sellers and experts in the moment, measures the quality and trust of every AI-generated insight, and feeds what it learns back into both the AI and the people. A core part of the strategy is building these capabilities or partnering where it makes sense with third-party vendors – all the while ensuring that the customer and conversational data stays inside Intuit’s trust boundary. The Role We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to define and drive the strategy and roadmap for Conversational Intelligence. As a most senior individual contributor in the area, you will own the multi-quarter product vision for an AI system that moves beyond simple transcripts to understand voice, video, screen context, and tone – in real time, at the scale of an entire expert network. You will lead through influence rather than a reporting line, setting direction for engineers, applied-AI scientists, designers, and business partners, and making the hard calls that determine whether AI genuinely makes experts and customers better. The Ideal Profile: You are an AI-first product leader, energized by hard, ambiguous problems at the intersection of large language models, real-time systems, and human expertise. You think in platforms, not features: you know durable scale comes from one reusable intelligence engine that many products and teams build on, not a sprawl of point tools. You are fluent enough in modern AI – multimodal models, streaming inference, evaluation and trust, and the cost–latency–quality trade-offs of production systems – to earn the respect of senior engineers and data scientists, and clear enough to make those trade-offs legible to executives and non-technical partners. You believe AI should make human experts better, not merely cheaper, and you obsess over systems that stay trustworthy in high-stakes, real-world moments. Responsibilities Product Vision & Strategy Define and own the multi-year vision and strategy for Conversational Intelligence – the AI platform that turns every customer–expert conversation into real-time, multimodal, trustworthy intelligence. Make the hard architectural product calls – multimodal-first vs. transcript-based, real-time vs. batch, first-party vs. third-party, platform vs. point product – and articulate the trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives. Hold a clean platform-versus-product boundary: build one reusable intelligence engine that many products, channels, and teams can adopt, so the platform is never coupled to a single product’s roadmap. Roadmap Ownership & Execution Own the roadmap end-to-end across data ingestion, real-time streaming, multimodal understanding, quality and trust, and self-serve onboarding. Drive delivery of in-the-moment guidance that meets real-time latency bars (roughly sub-three-second for chat and sub-1.5-second for voice) without trading away accuracy or depth of reasoning. Sequence the shift from third-party tools to first-party AI so that no team is ever stranded – each migration gated on the platform first reaching the capability it replaces. Customer & Expert Discovery Engage deeply with experts, sellers, managers, and the customers they serve to understand real conversations and the moments where AI can change the outcome. Translate field observation and quantitative signals into a roadmap that measurably improves resolution, conversion, handle time, and – critically – expert trust in the product. Outcome-Driven Leadership Define success metrics that reflect both experience and platform health: insight quality and trust, coverage, latency, privacy/compliance (such as accurate redaction of sensitive data), and adoption. Stand up the evaluation and feedback loops – automated “LLM-as-judge” scoring against expert-verified data, human-in-the-loop review, confidence scoring, and drift detection – that let the platform improve continuously and earn user trust. Influence & Product-Craft Leadership Operate as the most senior individual contributor in the area: set the bar for product craft, mentor and uplevel other product managers, and lead through influence rather than authority. Align senior stakeholders across multiple teams and businesses behind a single platform strategy, and drive clarity and decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations. Cross-Functional Partnership Partner closely with engineering, applied AI/ML and data science, design, analytics, privacy and compliance, and business and operations partners to embed the platform into live products. Act as a unifying force across teams – converging fragmented tools into one platform while keeping speed, depth, and trust in balance. Qualifications Product & Platform Experience 10+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of building and scaling complex platforms, AI/ML-powered products, or real-time, data-intensive systems. Proven ability to lead high-impact product areas end-to-end, from strategy through execution, delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes as a senior individual contributor – not solely through a reporting line. Experience with platforms, marketplaces, communications or conversational products, or other AI-enabled products is a strong plus. AI & Technical Fluency Deep, hands-on familiarity with modern AI: large language models, multimodal models (speech/audio and vision), retrieval and memory, and streaming/real-time inference, including the cost, latency, and quality trade-offs of running them in production. Comfortable owning AI-specific product concerns – evaluation (golden datasets and “LLM-as-judge”), human-in-the-loop quality, hallucination and confidence, model drift, and responsible-AI and privacy concerns such as redaction of personal data and regulatory compliance. Able to engage credibly in technical discussions on scalable, reliability-critical AI systems, and to make build-versus-buy and first-party-versus-third-party decisions. Analytical & Data-Driven Excellent analytical skills; uses data, experimentation, and qualitative insight to set direction and measure success – including for probabilistic AI systems, where “correct” is a distribution rather than a constant. Strongly Preferred Qualities Thrives in ambiguity – takes open-ended, cross-cutting problems and turns them into clear vision, strategy, and executable plans. Strategic & systems thinking – thinks holistically about customer journeys, expert workflows, AI systems, and platform trade-offs. Customer & expert obsession – a passion for building AI that works in real-world, high-stakes moments and makes human experts better. Influence & cross-functional leadership – a proven ability to align senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without formal authority. Executive communication – clearly articulates AI strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences. Operating across tens of thousands of experts, roughly 100 million customers, and billions of minutes of voice, video, screen-share, and chat each year, it is the authoritative source of truth for what happens in a conversation - and what to do about it. Most conversation analytics in the industry today, “transcribe-then-reason”: they convert speech to text, lose tone and on-screen context, and arrive seconds - or even hours - too late to change the outcome. We are building the opposite: a multimodal-first, real-time platform that reasons directly over audio, video, and screen streams; understands tone and intent, not just words; and delivers insight in under three seconds, live in the conversation. It coaches sellers and experts in the moment, measures the quality and trust of every AI-generated insight, and feeds what it learns back into both the AI and the people. A core part of the strategy is building these capabilities or partnering where it makes sense with third-party vendors - all the while ensuring that the customer and conversational data stays inside Intuit’s trust boundary. As a most senior individual contributor in the area, you will own the multi-quarter product vision for an AI system that moves beyond simple transcripts to understand voice, video, screen context, and tone - in real time, at the scale of an entire expert network. You will lead through influence rather than a reporting line, setting direction for engineers, applied-AI scientists, designers, and business partners, and making the hard calls that determine whether AI genuinely makes experts and customers better. The Ideal Profile: You are an AI-first product leader, energized by hard, ambiguous problems at the intersection of large language models, real-time systems, and human expertise. You think in platforms, not features: you know durable scale comes from one reusable intelligence engine that many products and teams build on, not a sprawl of point tools. You are fluent enough in modern AI - multimodal models, streaming inference, evaluation and trust, and the cost-latency-quality trade-offs of production systems - to earn the respect of senior engineers and data scientists, and clear enough to make those trade-offs legible to executives and non-technical partners. You believe AI should make human experts better, not merely cheaper, and you obsess over systems that stay trustworthy in high-stakes, real-world moments. Responsibilities Product Vision & Strategy Define and own the multi-year vision and strategy for Conversational Intelligence - the AI platform that turns every customer-expert conversation into real-time, multimodal, trustworthy intelligence. Make the hard architectural product calls - multimodal-first vs. transcript-based, real-time vs. batch, first-party vs. third-party, platform vs. point product - and articulate the trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives. The north-star measure of this work is Full Resolution Score—the percentage of contacts fully resolved in a single interaction. Your work is the engine behind the experience: build it once, serve it everywhere, and make every expert interaction faster, smarter, and more trusted. Responsibilities Responsibilities Own the platform roadmap for the capabilities that serve Product Support experts—case and context management, knowledge retrieval, intent understanding, AI-assisted guidance, and the learning loop that improves the system over time. Translate the business use cases and expert needs (defined in close partnership with business PMs) into well-scoped platform requirements, clear interfaces, and a milestone-driven delivery plan. Partner deeply with engineering and data science to design capabilities as reusable services—defining the contracts, quality bars, evaluation metrics, and latency/reliability targets that production demands. Drive the AI-enablement of these capabilities—bringing in LLM, retrieval, and intent-modeling techniques, and standing up the evaluation and guardrails that make them trustworthy enough to put in front of experts and customers. Define and instrument capability-level success metrics (coverage, accuracy/precision, latency, adoption, reliability) and hold the platform accountable to them. Sequence a bold platform vision into actionable increments your teams can ship with speed and clarity—starting from proven foundations and scaling deliberately. Manage cross-team dependencies and platform contracts so capabilities compose cleanly with adjacent systems (routing, identity, knowledge, expert workspace). title: Group Product Manager, Payroll Tax
jobDescription:
Company Overview Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With approximately 100 million customers worldwide using products such as Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, Quick Books, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible. The Opportunity Payroll tax is a promise. Every pay period, hundreds of thousands of small business employers and their accountants trust Quick Books Online Payroll to calculate, withhold, pay, and file their taxes correctly, on time, with zero errors. When we get it wrong, the consequences are real: penalties, eroded trust, and harm to the businesses that rely on us. We are looking for a Group Product Manager who starts from the customer and works backwards, and who believes that 99% accurate is not good enough. This leader will own the payroll tax product portfolio, covering tax calculations, automated payments, and tax filings, as well as the expert tools that power Intuit's managed payroll service. Their mandate is to define a bold vision for what error-free, AI-powered payroll tax compliance looks like, and to drive the organization to deliver against it, one edge case at a time. This role requires both lenses simultaneously: an uncompromising insistence on the highest quality bar across every compliance scenario, and the strategic clarity to build the roadmap for what payroll tax excellence looks like tomorrow. Above all, it requires a leader who stays deeply connected to what employers and accountants need, and galvanizes their team around delivering it. Responsibilities Portfolio Scope
1. Payroll Tax Calculations, Payments, and Filings Tax setup: Own the end-to-end experience for employers setting up their payroll taxes, including automated tax enrollment, state tax registration partnerships, and AI-powered tax guidance Automated tax payments: Own the strategy and execution for automated tax withholding and remittance, payment timing and compliance, and exception handling when payments fail Tax filings: Own quarterly and annual filing quality, tax filing accuracy and post-filing resolution workflows, year-end forms, Canadian filings, and improving the efficiency of tax operations workflows Multi-jurisdictional compliance: Translate federal, state, and local regulatory changes into product across all supported US and Canadian jurisdictions, with speed and precision
2. Expert Tools for Payroll Tax Operations Own the product tools used by Intuit's payroll tax experts, including systems that enable experts to monitor compliance, intervene on exceptions, and resolve issues at scale Drive automation of high-volume expert tasks: notice resolution workflows, amendment processing, exception triage, and audit documentation Own the managed payroll hub used in Intuit's title: Senior Accountant - Money Movement
jobDescription: This is an accounting role as a Senior Accountant on the Money Movement team within the Controllership, Assurance, and Operations (CAO) organization under the Shared Services team. title: Shared Services - Senior Revenue Accountant
jobDescription: This is an accounting role as a Senior Accountant on the Revenue Recognition team within the Controllership, Assurance, and Operations (CAO) organization. The position is located in Bangalore. The position will be responsible for applying revenue recognition principles through the performance of revenue accounting, while also charged with gaining efficiencies and work product improvements that address financial risk and support business growth. Intuit’s Finance team drives business growth and profitability through strategic, financial and operational leadership. Our team is comprised of finance, accounting, supply chain, corporate strategy, and development and tax professionals that support and enhance Intuit's operating efficiencies. Responsible for applying, enforcing, and executing the Company's revenue recognition policy as it relates to the performance of revenue accounting. Stay current on evolving Accounting Standards pronouncements and updates under prevailing regulatory bodies (FASB, SEC), incorporating into current Company policy as necessary. Apply professional skepticism and an inquisitive approach to review and analyze the appropriateness and reasonableness of underlying accounting principles that support revenue recognition. Work closely with business unit partners, accounting leads, and internal/external auditors on accounting matters. Comfortable working with cross functional teams in order to understand company offerings and implement accounting models that properly recognize revenue and expense according to accounting principles and company policy. Streamline systems and reporting tools to ensure efficient and accurate recording and classification of revenue. Establish controls necessary to ensure that revenue forecasts, deferred revenue balances and revenue accounting execution are compliant with Intuit company policy and GAAP. Prepare and maintain reports and analysis for management, as well as prepare schedules requested by internal and external auditors. Ability to manage complexity well and demonstrated experience managing across functions and businesses to accomplish large scale goals in a large, public company environment. Confidence, good judgment, energy, and personality to work in a dynamic, multi-business unit environment across all levels of management and across business units and functions. Strong end-to-end process orientation with demonstrated analytical thinking, organizational skills, and problem-solving skills. Ability to influence people indirectly and work with people in multi-functional roles. Excellent analytical and organizational skills, time prioritization, and risk assessment. Chartered Accountant/CPA with minimum of 4 years experience preferred. C andidates should have strong technical (GAAP) and financial accounting skills and Public accounting or large public company experience is strongly preferred. Software industry and Shared Service Center experience a plus Working knowledge of Oracle, Siebel/BRM, Black Line, and Qlik Sense is a plus.
